title: Data Protection Officer: Do You Need One to Sell by Email?
meta_description: You need a DPO if your core activities need regular and systematic monitoring at large scale. Email retargeting is a WP29 example. Germany adds 20 people.

image.takeaway: WP29 lists email retargeting as regular and systematic monitoring; scale and core activity also count.
image.alt: Hero card for an article on whether a company that sells by email needs a data protection officer under the GDPR, with email retargeting named as an example of monitoring and Germany’s 20-person rule.
